title: Telehealth Billing Documentation
content: Telehealth billing records should contain the service date, service type, provider information, billing amount, and relevant insurance information. Missing required billing information should be corrected before final submission.

title: Payment Reconciliation Guidance
content: Payment reconciliation compares the invoiced amount, insurance-approved amount, and payment received. Differences between the approved amount and payment received should be reviewed before closing the transaction.

title: Telehealth Consent Documentation
content: Telehealth workflows should maintain appropriate documentation of patient consent according to applicable organizational policies and requirements.

title: Missing Insurance Information
content: If an insurance identifier is missing from a billing transaction, the transaction should be reviewed and the missing information should be obtained before final billing.

title: Billing Error Review
content: Potential billing errors should be reviewed using the available evidence. The system should not assume missing information or label a transaction fraudulent without sufficient evidence.
